title: 喵斯兔补丁更新
content:
1、新增 Library 候选区支持：新下载的自制谱会默认进入候选区，不参与游戏启动加载，需要游玩时可在游戏内导入，大幅提升进游戏速度。
2、谱面管理设置新增“默认下载到候选区”开关，可自由选择新谱面下载到候选区或 Custom_Albums 正式区。
3、谱面管理工具箱新增“一键转移自制谱”，可以将 Custom_Albums 内的谱面转移到候选区，并尽量保留原有分类。
4、优化谱面查重功能：查重前可选择扫描 Custom_Albums 正式区或 Library 候选区，避免两个区域互相误判重复。
5、优化欢迎页与谱面管理对 Library 候选区的统计与展示兼容。
content_en:
1. Added Library candidate support: newly downloaded custom charts are saved to the candidate library by default, skipped during game startup, and can be imported in-game when needed. This greatly improves startup speed.
2. Added a Settings toggle for downloading charts to the candidate library by default. You can choose between Library and the active Custom_Albums folder.
3. Added a one-click transfer tool in Chart Manager Toolbox to move charts from Custom_Albums to the candidate library while preserving categories where possible.
4. Improved duplicate scanning: choose whether to scan active Custom_Albums or the Library candidate area first, preventing false duplicates between the two areas.
5. Improved Welcome page and Chart Manager compatibility for Library candidate chart counts and display.

title: 紧急修复
content:
请在北京时间5月26日23：30以前使用了一键安装自制谱的用户，重新点击一键安装自制谱按键，否则会导致：
[Red]在自定义分组内打出成绩的谱面移出分组后成绩会消失[/Red]
如无影响或在这个时间之后一键安装的用户可忽视这条公告。
content_en:
Users who used 'One-Click Install Custom Charts' before 23:30 (UTC+8) on May 26, please click the button again to reinstall. Otherwise, it will cause:
[Red]Scores achieved on charts within a custom group to disappear after moving the chart out of the group.[/Red]
Users unaffected or who installed after this time can ignore this announcement.
